runs.text: You look at the middle one. The searched value is greater: the left half is crossed out.
You look at the middle of what is left. The searched value is smaller: the right part is crossed out.
Few are left. You look at the middle one again.
It finds it. With 15 numbers, you never need more than 4 steps.
The plan of the binary search:

entries.text: If the secret is greater, what is possible starts after the middle; if smaller, it ends before.

runs.text: The new tool
There is no new construction. What is new is measuring. The
cost
of an algorithm is estimated by counting its steps in the worst case: one more counter inside the loop is enough.

points.text: A strategy is a way of solving a problem; brute force tries every possibility.
